notes.title: Mahou Mating Current State
notes.content:
Hey. This is an update for any of you who are looking forward to Mahou Mating and wondering what's going on with its development, and why it's taking so long to show any progress.

The game has been at a standstill for a while now, with very little progress being made. I announced a while back that I was discarding a lot of content from the currently-playable demo version and remaking everything from scratch. I even showed some examples of character art from a new artist I worked with in connection with Critical Bliss, the publisher. Since then, that arrangement proved to have its own difficulties. I'll spare the details, but rest assured, I knew things had to change again if this game was ever going to reach a final release.

I've once again had to find a new art team for the game, and I did so a few months ago now. Slimy Sextet, my other game currently in development, has had all of its art assets finished, and I've now hired Moruno Creative, the studio that made them, to now work on Mahou Mating's art. Since I've already worked with them before to successfully create a game's worth of great-looking assets, I feel very confident that they'll give this game a new, fresh look that will bolster the quality of the game.

You can see examples of Moruno Creative's excellent work on Slimy Sextet, which will be releasing in the coming months:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1189070/Slimy_Sextet/

In addition, I also have some big plans regarding the game's content. Rather than having all of the Cg artwork be static images with variations for facial expressions and such, I'm hoping to have most, if not all, CG and sex scenes be animated. As before, I'm also planning full voice acting, though that won't be close to ready for a good long time.

I apologize that things have taken so long to get moving since the game's original announcement, and original demo. I definitely didn't expect the game to have the development problems it had, but I am now more hopeful than ever that the game will reach a level of quality it couldn't have before.

I will need to focus on Slimy Sextet for a while still to finish it up and get it released to the public, but after that, I plan to finally focus on this game until it's finished, with nothing else to distract or delay from it.

Here are some previews of the newest sprites for the two girls of Mahou Mating, in Moruno Creative's style.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35481694/4b171683def7647f69ddc384655041b904f3cf93.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35481694/6db8e670eda326fb22122e95bf209eab09846940.png[/img]

I'll be posting more previews occasionally on my Discord server as art continues to be worked on.
https://discord.gg/7MSWqcQ

I hope you look forward to this game's new look, and are as excited as I am about the promise of the new style!

notes.title: Mahou Mating for Steam Game Festival
notes.content:
Hello everyone. I'm Belgerum, the dev behind Mahou Mating.

Mahou Mating is my fifth game, and it will be the biggest one yet. The game's script will be over 100,000 words long, using more art, music, voice acting, and other artistic assets than all my previous titles. I want to make this game the best experience I can produce, and set a new standard of quality that you can expect from me in the future.

Like my previous games, Mahou Mating is an adult visual novel focusing on fetishes of domination (both maledom and femdom), mindbreak, and corruption. The game contains various hardcore themes that some may consider offensive, such as non-consensual sex, and is not intended to appeal to everyone. If you enjoy this kind of content, however, then rest assured that the game will showcase said content completely uncensored, and without the need for any external patch or mod. Many thanks to Valve for allowing this, and letting me produce the content I enjoy without restrictions.

The playable demo for Mahou Mating was released earlier this year, but I've made a few improvements since then, including newly reworked music tracks, a revised voice-loop system, and other small details.

But this is only the beginning of Mahou Mating's development journey. After releasing the demo, I entered negotiations with publisher Critical Bliss, who I've partnered with to bring this game to new heights. With additional funding and connections to other skilled professionals in the industry, Mahou Mating is undergoing a transformation, and will emerge even more beautiful than before.

Planned changes to the game's original draft include:
[list][*] all character art will be redone in a new, improved style, with extra features and variants.
[*] GUI will be improved with additional functions and better appearance.
[*] The story will be lengthened with 6 more sex scenes and 2 more endings.
[*] 2 more endings featuring femdom content (so femdom fans can reach satisfying story conclusions without interacting with maledom content if they wish)
[*] An expanded soundtrack with more music.
[*] Potentially recasting one of the voice actresses.[/list]

The reworked character designs are still being worked on, but here's a peek at what they might look like:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35481694/14a4a7c57544d53da4cae7c54770125214f08e6c.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35481694/4e70ea81d5b9f8e40df597a008a38afbc492b4d6.png[/img]

Before too long, I hope to showcase the new style of the game with a revamped version of the current demo. While I regret not having it available for the Steam Game Festival, it will arrive soon, and I hope all of you will then be able to appreciate just how much Critical Bliss and I are investing in this project in order to make an amazing western eroge for customers like you.

We don't have a release date planned for the full game quite yet, given the numerous changes in plans that are occurring. However, we are hoping to bring the game to you before the end of 2020, for a retail price of $14.99 USD at launch.

Thanks for your support, and I hope you look forward to Mahou Mating!
